build_fp8_mm_kernel: build an FP8-compatible matrix multiplication kernel with quantization support for Triton GPU execution
run_shrink_kernel_fp8: run the LoRA shrink kernel that computes matrix product and stores results with FP8 quantization support
run_expand_kernel_fp8: run the LoRA expand kernel that computes FP8 matrix product with dequantization and stores results
test_accumulate_mm: test the core matrix multiplication accumulation logic with block-wise and tensor-wise quantization paths
refactor_fp8_kernel: refactor the FP8 kernel utilities to support configurable block-wise quantization group sizes
